description: Which card, if any, a scanned QR payload selects in a deck (game-rules.md section 8.2 resolveScan), shared by Apple and web. `hosts` are the configured Eratic card hosts, compared with the payload host as exact strings after ASCII-only lowercasing (no Unicode case mapping or canonical equivalence). Decks are valid version 1 or 2 decks. `expected` is the exact result object; kinds: card (cardId, via), unknownCard (cardId), otherDeck (deckId), unmatchedProvider (provider, trackId), unmatchedOfficial, unrecognized.
